name: The Dylan Amsterdam
insider_take: This intimate boutique gem occupies a historic 1634 theater building in Amsterdam's prestigious Keizersgracht canal district, where literary legend meets luxury hospitality.
whats_special: The Dylan's uniquely designed rooms each tell a different story, from Oriental opulence to minimalist chic. The hotel sits on the famous Keizersgracht canal - one of Amsterdam's UNESCO World Heritage ring canals - and houses the acclaimed Keizersgracht Restaurant helmed by a Michelin-trained chef.
pro_tip: Book a canal-view room on the upper floors for unobstructed views of the historic waterway, and request dinner reservations well in advance as the restaurant only seats 40 guests.
dont_miss: The hotel's dramatic courtyard garden oasis hidden behind the historic facade, and take a evening stroll to the nearby Negen Straatjes (Nine Streets) - Amsterdam's most charming shopping district just 2 minutes away, filled with vintage boutiques and cozy brown cafés.
pros: Historic 17th-century building with unique architectural character
Prime location in Amsterdam's UNESCO-listed canal district
Luxurious boutique accommodations with personalized service
Award-winning restaurant Kamer 01 with innovative cuisine
cons: Historic building may have smaller room sizes
